points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving reliability of data synthesis for complex modeling tasks.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for clinical development insights.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring rigorous validation of generative outputs.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing processing overhead by ~80% per query and enabling efficient handling of clinical data sets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in optimizing trial design efficiency.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for digital twin generation.
